gaps.missing_rtl: DMA write-back partner (wb_ready, wa[12] into hb_dbk_<q>; consumer of wd[2312] + wb_reserve_*/wb_fill_*): the real successor exists on main (ot_hbm_svc_wb_block_cdc / _pipeline_cdc: reserve/fill/wd -> two-buffer WB SRAM -> CDC -> 32 HBM K write ports per stack, wa = posted sectors on true PHY completion; composed with this DMA in ot_hgi_b2_swap_wb_grp_static.sv) but every HBM controller K port of the v16 die is owned by an svg_<q><k> read feed (4 PCs each). Binding the WB needs an architecture decision: (a) a static K-port time slot shared by svg read feed and WB write (fixed calendar slot in the feed issuer), or (b) dedicated write PCs. wa/wb_ready are true off-die completion signals and cannot be produced by a dispatcher.
gaps.note: cp1 closes the DMA command side (cycle/mv_v/mv/issue_at/drain_at/mv_wb_bank/mv_wb_epoch).

notes: ONE new master ot_static_cmd_target (MODE 0 run collar for 32 svg, MODE 1 command calendar for 4 x-load + 4 DMA) + the existing ot_static_program_target for the 4 VM calendars. All collars take the raw host F20 broadcast; every input is pin-flopped and every output is a flop (owner 19:50). Fixed latencies: cfg row -> target window write 2 edges after cfg_v at the collar pin; launch_v -> run_v 2 edges; MODE 1: a table entry fires (cmd_v at the collar pin) when the exported cycle == C + 2 + LEAD(8) + loop*period + at, C = cycle value in the launch_v pin cycle; x-load / DMA add their own command-pin edge on top (cl2 ctl cmd_v pin flop; DMA DESC_LAT4). Table read is one entry per 3 edges sustained (2-deep prefetch: 2 back-to-back after a gap); a command whose cycle passes before it reaches the head is a sticky FAULT, never a late issue (static schedule, no ready/credit). Status: each collar exports configured/fault/active (status_outputs); cp2 joins them into the ingress block_ready/program_active/program_fault. Physical: the 256-b cfg_data broadcast now has ~48 more sinks (44 collars + COLL); it is install-time only but single-cycle at 1.2 GHz, so the parent must give it a pipelined relay tree (fixed edges, the collars are edge-count agnostic: install latency only). No target RTL changed (svg/calendar/xload/DMA tiles untouched; no re-closure). Bench: rtl/hbm_accel/host_static_20261015/tb_static_cmd_target.sv.
